nodes.label: Data passing from CR
nodes.description: Root concept: how data flows out from a cloud resource into other components in KubeVela.

nodes.label: 1. Pass Secret
nodes.description: Strategy of passing the entire Secret object generated by the cloud resource to downstream consumers.

nodes.label: 1.1 read-object + export-data: OK
nodes.description: Use read-object trait combined with export-data trait to pass secret. Marked OK / feasible.

nodes.label: 1.2 read-object + deploy + override: OK, but more complicated
nodes.description: Use read-object together with deploy workflow step and override policy. Feasible but more complex.
nodes.norm_label: 1.2 read-object + deploy + override: ok, but more complicated

nodes.label: 2. Pass Value
nodes.description: Strategy of passing individual values extracted from the cloud resource (rather than full Secret).

nodes.label: output problem
nodes.description: Sub-area of Pass Value concerning how to output / expose values from the cloud resource.

nodes.label: input problem
nodes.description: Sub-area of Pass Value concerning how to consume / input values into a component.

nodes.label: 2.1 [Hard] Read from Configuration status
nodes.description: Reading values from Configuration CR status. Marked Hard because Configuration is not rendered from CUE.

nodes.label: 2.2 Read from Secret
nodes.description: Approach of reading values from the Secret produced by the cloud resource.

nodes.label: 2.2.1 [Hard] Can not refer directly
nodes.description: Secret cannot be referenced directly because it is not managed and dispatched by the Application.

nodes.label: 2.2.2 [Hard] Use ref-objects
nodes.description: Use ref-objects to reference the Secret, but AppRev won't allow the object to not exist when dispatching App for now.

nodes.label: 2.2.3 [Medium] Use ref-objects in override
nodes.description: Use ref-objects inside override policy to avoid the AppRev problem, but override does not support input/output now.
